# DayRecall

> DayRecall is an AI memory app for Apple Watch and iPhone, made for people who forget things. During the hours you choose, it listens, keeps what was said as text on your iPhone (the audio is deleted), and answers questions about your day with the exact words and where they came from. Everything stays on your devices: there is no account and no DayRecall server.

DayRecall 是一款适用于 Apple Watch 和 iPhone 的 AI 记忆 App，写给容易忘事的人：在你选定的时段里替你听着，把说过的话变成文字存在 iPhone 上（录音随即删除），随时回答关于这一天的问题，并给出原话和出处。

## Key facts

- Devices: best with Apple Watch; an iPhone can also listen on its own. When both listen, the day is one timeline, and what both heard is shown once. Requires iOS 26 and watchOS 26 or later.
- The watch does not need the iPhone nearby. It keeps its recordings and sends them to the iPhone every two hours, or as soon as the two reconnect.
- On the watch, an in-house ultra-light speech model (2,561 parameters, custom accelerated inference kernels) checks every 0.1 seconds whether someone is talking and keeps only speech.
- Lab results for that model: 99.9% of speech kept on the AMI Meeting Corpus test set; 95% of background-noise time skipped on the DEMAND dataset.
- Internal testing: on Apple Watch Series 11, listening adds about 0.9% battery per hour; on iPhone 17 Pro Max, 3 minutes of conversation are processed in 17 seconds.
- Speech becomes text on the iPhone and the audio is then deleted. Answers come from Apple's on-device model. Nothing leaves the iPhone unless the user turns on their own cloud API or hands a day to an AI app.
- Optional speaker marking: after reading five short cards (about a minute), the user's lines are marked "Me" and everyone else "Other 1", "Other 2" and so on. Only the user's voiceprint is stored, on the iPhone.
- Optional multilingual transcription: up to three languages in one conversation, each part transcribed in the language it was spoken in, with translation into the user's language. The app itself is available in 13 languages.
- Status: in beta, coming soon to the App Store.
